Whether you’re chasing a high score or just unwinding, this game offers the perfect mix of challenge and comfort.

title: Russian Derby Crash
description:
Russian Derby Crash is a thrilling game that immerses you in the atmosphere of spectacular car racing with elements of destruction. You'll control one of five Russian cars or a tank. Destroy cars on the training ground and unlock new ones!
This game has a unique twist: in addition to cars, there's a tank on the training ground, from which you can shoot at other participants!

title: Pixel Blast
description: Pixel Blast is a colorful online arcade game that mixes classic gameplay with modern design. Play for free on your phone or computer and enjoy smooth controls and vibrant pixel art. It’s easy to pick up and fun for players of all ages.

title: Sprunki Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Sprunki Jigsaw Puzzle is a fun jigsaw puzzle game. You can select one of the fifteen images and then select one of the four modes (16, 36, 64 and 100 pieces). Select your favorite picture and complete the jigsaw in the shortest time possible! Have fun and enjoy!

title: Idle Dice 3D: Incremental Game
description:
In this game, you roll dice and accumulate coins. Upgrade dice to generate more coins, even when you are not actively playing (Offline earnings).

Idle Dice 3D stands out with its variety of dice: from classic six-sided to dice with 2, 4, 8, 10, 12, and 20 sides. Aim for combinations like pairs, triples, straights, and more to increase profit.

The Prestige system allows you to reset your progress to boost future earnings, adding a strategic element to the game. The game also has achievements.

title: Serious Bro
description: Defend your base against adorable alien invaders using an M16 Carbine Rifle and frag grenades. Experience a beautiful low poly 3D environment with cute enemies and simple controls for both desktop and mobile.

title: Art Salon
description: Welcome to Art Salon - Makeup & Nails, where your creativity knows no bounds! ? Whether you're passionate about fashion, beauty care, or just looking for a fun, relaxing game, this is the perfect app for you. From designing acrylic nails to creating stunning makeup looks, step into a world of endless beauty transformations in 3D! ??

title: Arrow Tap Puzzle
description: Arrows fill the board like traffic at a silent crossing. Some lanes are open, others blocked. Remove arrows one by one, avoid blocked paths and keep your daily streak alive. Solve the arrangement in front of you, then step into another.

title: Only Up
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey from ground zero to the skies in Only Up! However, there's a twist – there are no checkpoints on this ascent. Stumble, and you must swiftly catch yourself to avoid losing precious progress. Will you conquer the summit, or succumb to the challenge and give up?

title: Floof My Pet House
description: Welcome to Floof - My Pet House, a casual pet simulation game for kids online. If you love playing with cats and dogs, or are looking for lovely and relaxing games online, do not hesitate to join H5games4u's best animal care game. You will take care of a puppy or a cute cat, feed them, dress them up, and play minigames with them. Earn enough coins to upgrade your pet house and buy more furniture.

title: Cute Rabbit's Challenging Adventure
description: Accompany the cute rabbit's adventure together and have fun. I think it will be a little difficult to progress on the challenging tracks consisting of 5 sections in total. Avoid dangers and destroy enemies. Overcome obstacles and have fun times.

title: Stickman in space
description:
You have to play as a Stickman astronaut who is stuck on the moon.
Use all possible ways to leave the moon and get to our planet Earth.
On the way you will encounter various dangers, such as aliens, flying meteorites and much more.
You will have several objects in your hands with which you can try to escape from the natural satellite of the moon. Several objects will lead you to death, and some objects can save your life, be careful and cautious.

title: Maze Escape Challenge
description: Maze Escape Challenge is a fast-paced maze game where you must reach the exit as quickly as possible. Each level features a unique labyrinth with increasing difficulty, traps, and surprises. Some levels include Dark Mode, where you can see only a small light around the player. Earn stars by finishing mazes fast (1–3 stars), unlock new levels, beat your best times, and try to master every maze.

title: Heist Defender
description: "Heist Defender" immerses players in the heart-pounding world of high-stakes bank robberies, where they take on the role of an elite security expert tasked with preventing a daring heist. As the mastermind behind the bank's defense systems, players must employ strategic thinking, quick reflexes, and cutting-edge technology to thwart the cunning thieves and protect the bank's vault from being plundered.

title: Fashion Battle for Survival
description: In this puzzle game you have to test your memory by guessing the cards in pairs. Each correctly guessed pair brings you closer to winning the game round. And each successfully completed round opens the doors to the world of fashion, allowing you to dress up the main character of the game - an Asian beauty with a daring character. Remember that the time to complete the round is limited by a timer.

title: Tailor Stylist: Fashion Diary
description: Welcome to Tailor Stylist: Fashion Diary – the place where your style dreams come to life! Step into the shoes of a talented fashion designer, build your own boutique, and create stunning outfits that dazzle the world. From fabric to final look, you’re in charge of every stitch!

title: Car Crash Test: Abandoned City
description: Car Crash Test: Abandoned City throws you into a thrilling sandbox of chaos and destruction. Explore a vast, deserted city where every street is your testing ground. Drive, crash, and experiment with powerful vehicles while mastering realistic physics and dynamic crash effects. Whether you’re speeding down empty highways or performing daring stunts, this game lets you push every car — and your reflexes — to the limit.

title: Mr Throw
description: Mr Throw is a game in which even an old teddy bear can become a deadly weapon! Calculate the strength and direction of the throw and throw at the enemy all the things that come to hand! Victory in this dangerous garbage battle!

title: We Are In A Simulation Simulator
description: We Are In A Simulation Simulator challenges you to question nothing and mimic everything. Blend in by copying the actions of others to survive in a strange digital world where free will doesn’t exist. Stay alert, follow the crowd, and don’t get caught acting out of sync. Play for free online on mobile or desktop and test your ability to conform in this mysterious simulation!

title: Going Balls Adventure 2
description: Going Balls Adventure 2 is a ball-rolling arcade game with a 3D game engine. Your main mission is to collect black balls and reach the checkpoint. Your side mission is to collect all coins on the platform. It doesn't matter if you don't fish the job. Before the level begins, you have a chance to try some free skins for you to decide on a favorite one.

title: Woody Hexa
description: Woody Hexa is a visually engaging puzzle game that challenges players to complete 250 levels by strategically arranging hexagonal blocks by color. With simple drag-and-drop controls and increasingly complex layouts, each level tests your logic and spatial awareness. Combining relaxing gameplay with clever merging mechanics, Woody Hexa offers a satisfying brain workout perfect for all ages.

title: Hole Battle.io
description:
The battle between the holes is beginning in the arena! Pick your hole and join this battle! Eat fruits, planes, cars, and many things that come to mind, and grow as much as you can! Your goal is to eat things that are smaller than you and make your hole bigger than the enemy's. Avoid bigger holes and try to collect power-ups besides eatable items.
Four different great maps are waiting for you:
- 2048 Map
- World Map
- Stationary Map
- Kitchen Map

title: Fighter Stick Hero
description: Welcome to Figher Stick Hero Stickman, an exhilarating 2D stickman game that will test your dueling skills. Whether you're playing in an arcade or survival mode, get ready to engage in intense battles against your opponents. Choose from a variety of weapons, character colors, and character decorations to customize your stickman. Remember to attack while moving to gain an advantage and earn higher scores by defeating other stickmen.

title: Ultra Pixel Survive 2
description:
Command heroes with unique abilities, gather natural resources to produce materials, then build and develop your military defenses.
Enemy hordes will attack the village, challenging your strategic and tactical abilities to survive. Explore dark underground dungeons and battle against gigantic bosses!
Features
Build and upgrade your resources and heroes
Set up defenses, hunt, cook, and much more
Unlock new characters
Action RPG and survival gameplay
Beautiful epic fantasy pixel art

title: Bubble Shooter Crystal Hunt
description: Bubble Shooter Crystal Hunt is an exciting endless bubble-shooting puzzle game where players must collect specific target bubbles along with rare magical crystals that appear among the bubbles. Aim carefully and match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear space while the bubble wall slowly moves toward the border line, increasing tension with every shot. Crystals are hidden within bubble clusters and must also be collected to progress and boost scores.

title: Puzzle Box Brain Fun
description: Puzzle Box - Brain Fun is a brain game containing multiple modes. Different levels of difficulty and gameplay are waiting for you to unlock! Challenge your intelligence while enjoying casual games! Come and challenge Puzzle Box - Brain Fun to test your IQ and play with your brain! Start when you are ready and show your strength!

title: Stickman Warrior Way
description:
Epic battles, complex labyrinths with multiple paths and treacherous enemies await you in the game!

You will have to pass difficult tests in the fight against an ancient evil that wants to destroy all existing worlds.
 Only you can prevent the destruction of the universe and save other worlds from destruction.

18 challenging levels and mazes are waiting for you.
2 or more ways to pass the level
Save this world to give the rest of the universe a chance!

title: Beat The Zombies
description: Beat the Zombies is a vertical action RPG blending strategy and adventure. Explore a dangerous plant-zombie world, fight through stages, and defeat all plant zombies in your way!

title: Doodle Dino Run
description: Doodle Dino Run delivers an addictive running adventure where you control a cute dinosaur, avoid dangers, and push your distance record farther every time you play. Featuring smooth side-scrolling gameplay, precise jump timing is essential to survive. Packed with action, this dinosaur adventure challenges your reflexes as the speed continuously increases.

title: Arrow Escape: Puzzle
description:
“Arrow Escape: Puzzle” is a logic puzzle where arrows block each other, and your goal is to untangle routes and clear the level by choosing the correct move order.

- Short levels you can play in a minute.  
- Focus on logic and move order, not speed.  
- Simple controls: one tap — one move.

title: Gladiator Fights
description: An action game based on battles with gladiators, where players can plunge into the world of ancient Rome and become real warriors. The game offers an exciting and dynamic gameplay where players have to go through many challenges and defeat a number of dangerous opponents.

title: Fishing Baron Real Fishing
description: Fishing Baron Real Fishing is a casual fishing simulator that offers a realistic fishing experience. Enjoy a relaxing and challenging fishing journey. Become a fishing master. Start a fishing adventure across various beautiful fishing locations. From lakes to oceans, you can unlock different areas to fish. Each location has unique fish species and environments.

title: Save Her Tour
description: This complex and relaxing puzzle game you've read about has finally become a reality! Only the smartest can pass these brain teaser quizzes and save the girl! Each level will give you a scenario where you must use your ingenuity to solve the problem. If you mess up, it won't end well for our heroine. There are so many different challenges waiting to be solved. This is the best puzzle game ever! Solve interesting puzzles, protect the girl from harm, and experience the thrill of success.

title: Treasure Hunt Puzzle
description: Explore ruins, complete stone tablet puzzles, and collect treasures! Solve each puzzle by fitting all your blocks into the board using the symbols as hints.

title: Forest Match 4
description: Forest Match 4 is back with the highly anticipated fourth chapter of the beloved Match 3 series! Return to the enchanting forest to collect juicy fruits, uncover hidden coin chests, and discover sparkling gems across 4,620+ exciting levels. Follow your fairy guide back to the charming village and journey along a beautifully crafted saga map. Can you complete level goals with limited moves? Use powerful boosters when you need an extra push.

title: Click Kitty Idle
description:
Click Kitty Idle– Fast-Paced Cat Clicker Challenge!

Once you’ve earned $20,000, unlock Bus Mode and take the wheel of a bus. Reach $30,000, and Chopper Mode lets you pilot a helicopter. Feeling cash-strapped? Watch ads to claim $10,000 each time!

title: BlowUp ATM
description: BlowUp ATM – The ultimate heist action game where you become a master thief! Your mission? Plant explosives, blow up ATMs, and grab as much cash as you can before escaping! But beware – the cops are always on high alert!

title: Cooking Stories: Fun cafe game
description:
Become the host of the popular transformation cooking show — Cooking Stories! You are not just a chef, you are a culinary genius, a style master, and an interior designer. Participants come to you at their most desperate moment: they urgently need help — and only you can change and save their lives!

But that’s not all...  
Take a peek behind the scenes of the TV show: intrigue, emotions, unexpected twists — all this in the game Cooking Stories!

title: Bounce Dunk Basketball
description: Love basketball? Want to master the art of bouncing and dunking? In Bounce Dunk - Basketball, you must skillfully control the balls bounce to make perfect shots and get high scores. Tap the screen to control the angle and strength of the basketball so that the ball bounces perfectly into the basket. Or destroy enemies, get coins, etc.

title: Capybara Xmas Merge
description:
Capybara Xmas Merge is a cute and cozy holiday game where you combine adorable Christmas capybaras!
Drop festive capybaras into the box, watch them roll and bump into each other, and merge into bigger, funnier holiday characters.
Create giant capybaras, score points, and enjoy the warm winter atmosphere.

title: Ragdoll Football 2 Players
description: Ragdoll Football 2 players is an exciting and fun sports game in which you can feel like a real football player! Fight with friends or the computer by controlling a ragdoll stickman on the football field. Show your skills and wit to score grand goals and become a champion.

title: Tap Car
description:
Unveil stunning car masterpieces by solving image puzzles. Every tap reveals more of the picture—can you uncover them all? A must-play for car enthusiasts and puzzle lovers alike!

Would you like a few more variations depending on the tone you're aiming for (like more casual, exciting, or elegant)?

title: Qube 2048
description: We present a unique arcade game that combines the dynamic gameplay of Q*bert and the mechanics of 2048!  You start with the number 2 and move across a grid of blocks, doubling its value. The goal is to reach the maximum number by planning your moves and avoiding obstacles.

title: Sort Parking
description: Sort cars by type. You cannot park in a full parking lot. Cars cannot be placed in front of different types. You can increase the number of car models with coins available in the game. If you clear many stages, you will get pieces for the background. When pieces of the same type are matched, the background is completed and the background can be changed.

title: Noob vs Zombie Apocalypse: shooting pro
description:
Post-apocalypse! Noob finds himself alone against zombies. Passing levels, he accumulates coins and picks up weapons.
There is a grenade launcher, a pistol, an uzi, a shotgun, a machine gun, a laser pistol, a rifle, a laser rifle - and so on!

Noob vs Zombie Apocalypse: shooting pro is an epic noob game in the world, similar to minecraft fnaf. Noob shoots at zombies with a variety of weapons like a rambo. Noob miner starts his fighting fnaf survival!

There are 60 levels and 15 bosses in total!

title: Memory Wars
description: Memory Wars takes the classic memory-matching game to a whole new level with exciting battles, unique enemies, and powerful card effects. Use your brainpower and tactics to overcome a variety of foes and emerge victorious in every stage!

title: Throne vs Balloons
description: In this unique and dynamic game, your attention and dexterity will be put to the test when you control a bouncing ball and use its sharp spikes to break through obstacles and pop balloons.

title: Idle Dairy Farm Tycoon
description: Idle Dairy Farm Tycoon is a relaxing and strategic idle game where players grow and manage their very own dairy business. Start by raising cows to produce milk, process raw milk then deliver the fresh milk packages to the market. Automate processes, upgrade your workers and warehouse to maximize efficiency and profits. Your goal is to build the ultimate dairy empire! Perfect for players who enjoy business simulation games.

title: Exit - Puzzle
description: Embark on an exciting journey in Exit - Puzzle, a captivating game where your mission is to rotate the puzzle and guide the ball to the exit! Each level presents new challenges, requiring you to think creatively and find the best route. Twist and turn the puzzle to navigate through obstacles and unlock the path forward. With a variety of levels and progressively harder puzzles, this game will keep you entertained and engaged.

title: Burger Empire
description:
Welcome to Burger & Beans Cafe, the ultimate restaurant-management game where you cook juicy burgers, brew the perfect coffee, and build the eatery of your dreams!

• Serve Delicious Orders: Flip patties and pour lattes for hungry customers—fast!
• Earn & Upgrade: Collect coins to unlock chic new tables, comfy booths, and vibrant dining areas.
• Customize Your Space: Choose décor, layout, and special menu items to keep guests coming back.

title: Dusty Maze Hunter
description:
Dusty Maze Hunter beckons you to a distinctive maze adventure, blending puzzle-solving with strategic gameplay.

Tailored for puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers, it promises an exhilarating journey through labyrinthine rooms filled with diverse obstacles. As you progress through multiple levels, you'll have the chance to refine your problem-solving skills and strategic thinking.

Are you prepared to unleash your strategy and triumph over the dust? The maze adventure awaits!

title: Bubble Ball
description: Bubble Ball is an untimed bubble-popping strategy game with a classic interface and arcade special effects noises. The player uses an arrow shooter to pop clusters of three or more matching bubbles to earn points and special gifts.

title: High Heels 2
description: Stack rider new run adventure game with high heels, swipe to collect heels and make tall stack heels, and cross bricks and reach the destination. Have a good time.

title: Three Chickens
description:
Hurry up! The chickens are coming home to roost.

Drag and drop the chicken into the tiles to match them.

Match 3 or more chickens to eliminate them.

How high can you score in this endless match 3 game?

title: 2-3-4 Player Games
description: These games can be played with 2, 3, or 4 players. You can play 21 unique games with your friends, each with different scenarios. The objective of each game is to either score or be the first to reach the finish line. Move swiftly and outpace your opponents! It's time to enjoy with friends!

title: Miracle Mahjong
description: The panda has a challenge for you. You will face five tests on your way to the top. Attempt to finish all stages and earn the honor of being a Mahjong master.

title: Run 3D
description: The infinite running platformer game Run 3D takes place in the immensity of space. The character must be navigated by players through the constantly shifting space. Go, leap, and keep yourself from plummeting into the chasm!

title: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park
description: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park is a horror escape adventure where bright amusement park rides hide lurking dangers. Players must solve puzzles, collect items, and uncover clues while evading hostile enemies. Stealth and timing are crucial—explore cautiously, hide when needed, and outsmart the threats to survive and escape. The mix of colorful setting and eerie tension creates a unique, suspenseful experience.

title: Popcorn Stack
description: Welcome to Popcorn Stack! Here, you will have a fun stacking popcorn trip. Collect many boxes and fill them with grain, sprinkle them with choco, bake and other food. Pack them up, cover them, and decorate them with fancy wings.

title: Animal Royal
description:
"The ultimate player versus player game allows players to engage in battles against their opponents using unique animals."
You'll be challenged to use your wits and strategy to outsmart your opponents and emerge victorious.
Animal Royal is a game that features a wide variety of animals and birds, each with its unique strengths and weaknesses.
Your goal is to protect your meat from being eaten by your opponent's animals while sending your animals to eat as much meat as possible to win the battle.

title: Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up
description: Dress up your paper doll with mystical styles in Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up! ?✨ Get ready to enter a dreamy world where fantasy meets fashion. This isn’t just a dress-up game—it’s your magical escape, where every outfit tells a story and every style reveals a spellbound secret. Whether you're a fashion dreamer, a lover of magic, or a diary keeper at heart, this enchanted adventure is made just for you.

title: Hamstercycle
description:
Help a genius hamster bust out of a mad professor's lab on his slick DIY ride - the Hamstercycle!

Jump across furniture and whatever junk the prof left lying around to reach the portal at the end of each room. But watch out - the floor is guarded by laser sensors! Touch it, and the hamster gets caught!

Fun physics, simple controls, and hundreds of exciting levels await!

title: Dino Hunter King
description: Action-packed FPS games have long attracted players. Enjoy dinosaur hunting in Dino Hunter King. Enter a wild prehistoric world, become an elite hunter tracking powerful dinosaurs across open grasslands.

title: Demolition Derby Derby
description: Welcome to Demolition Derby the mobile sensation where you control the chaos! Strategically tap to toss dynamite and swipe to send rocks crashing down. Decimate buildings and statues with precision in this hyper-casual game.

title: Falling Art Ragdoll Simulator
description:
The harder they fall, the more points they get!

Jump in and enjoy the beauty of falling art! Because let’s be honest - there is nothing more satisfying than watching someone hurt themselves in the most dumb and ridiculous way. Especially when that someone is a 3d model with ragdoll physics and you don’t need to feel sorry for it at all!
 
Just enjoy our crazy game, have fun, and stay safe!

title: Boost Your Brain!
description: "Boost Your Brain!" is an exciting incremental game where you develop your mind by collecting Aiku! Click the magic book, upgrade skills, collect pets with bonuses, and customize with skins. Enjoy deep progression, endless leveling, and cute companions. Reach new heights and become a genius!

title: Color Conquest: Territory War
description:
Command one of 4 unique factions in this intense RTS war! Capture territories to expand your army and destroy enemy bases.

Factions:

Grey: High HP (Tank), slow production.

Green: Fast spawn (Swarm), low HP.

Blue & Yellow: Balanced fighters.

Capture neutral zones to increase your unit capacity. Can you dominate the map?

title: Witchy and the Puzzle Adventures
description: Help the brave Witch to pass all the puzzling tests and find all the seals to shelter them in her cozy forest house. Kittens are lost in the forest, which is full of various traps and dangers, you need to help the Witch to pass all the tests and find all the seals.

title: Parking Driver
description: Ever struggled to find a parking spot? In "Parking Driver," you'll face tricky parking challenges! From tight parallel parking to complex reverse maneuvers, you need precise control to avoid obstacles and park perfectly in the shortest time. The game features a realistic physics engine and diverse level designs, each testing your patience and skill. Come prove your driving prowess, unlock cool new cars, and conquer every parking lot!

title: Pentaword
description: Guess the hidden five-letter word in just six tries! Use logic, spelling, and word skills in this brain teaser. Can you crack the Pentaword?

title: Cosmic Aviator
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey through the depths of the cosmos in Cosmic Aviator! In this pulse-pounding arcade-style game, you find yourself piloting a sleek aircraft that's trapped within a twisting and treacherous tunnel of unknown origin. Your mission? Navigate through the endless labyrinth of obstacles and hazards while collecting valuable power-ups to boost your score to new heights.

title: Solitaire Klondike: Eternal Russian Classic
description:
Rediscover the captivating world of Solitaire Klondike!

This timeless card game not only entertains but also enhances logical thinking, offering hours of engaging pastime. Play your favorite solitaire anytime, anywhere.

Join the community of enthusiasts and prove your mastery in Klondike!

Keep an eye on the leaderboard and become the top player among all!

title: Smash Defense
description: Smash Defense is a chaotic baseball-inspired action game where your swings decide the fate of entire worlds. Crush waves of flying monsters using your bat and evolve your ball with fiery, electric, and explosive powers. Travel through dynamic environments like deep oceans and erupting volcanoes, upgrade your skills, and prove you’re the ultimate monster-slaying champion.

title: Plane Chase
description:
Ever watched a plane soar across the blue sky and thought, 'Hey, I could catch that… in my car!'? Well, your oddly specific and gravity-defying dreams are about to come true in 'Plane Chase'!

Fasten your seatbelts, rev the engine, and remember: it's not car theft if you're aiming for the plane! Are you ready for takeoff in the wackiest chase ever? Download 'Plane Chase' and steer your way through this high-flying, tire-screeching adventure. The skies are literally not the limit!

title: Merge Shooter
description: In "Merge Shooter," defend the galaxy by merging turrets to fight off alien invaders. Enhance your defense with special powers, navigating through levels filled with challenges. With its colorful graphics and user-friendly interface, it's an exciting adventure for all ages. Become the galaxy's hero by proving your achievements in this dynamic gameplay experience.

title: Obby Champions
description: A journey awaits you where every wall is a challenge, every obstacle is an ancient seal, and every punch is a step towards legend. Explore unique zones, fight titans, and find rare pets with unique abilities. Enter hidden codes, collect fragments of history, and leave your mark in the Hall of Echoes - only the strongest will be able to break all the seals and become the Fist of Legends!

title: Space Survivor
description: Jump right into the action, fighting dangerous aliens and executing amazing maneuvers! Sharpen your weapons and skills, you will need them to last as long as possible.

title: Minicraft Chef Cake Wars
description: Hey player, would you like to have a cooking competition with your friend? In this cooking contest, you must beat your friend. Collect all the cooking materials as quickly as possible. We need to gather the cake ingredients floating in balloons in the air. The player who collects the most ingredients the fastest wins the game. To bake the cake, collect everything: salt, flour, and milk. Gather all the ingredients and win the game!

title: Jungle Match Adventures
description: Jungle Match Adventures is a brand-new Match-3 game set deep in the lush Amazon Rainforest. Join the fearless explorer Aria as she uncovers hidden treasures, ancient relics, and precious gems buried in the jungle. Match colorful stones and nature-themed items, solve fun and challenging puzzles, and unlock secrets along the way. Take part in Daily and Weekly Challenges, enjoy Daily Surprises, and progress through hundreds of exciting levels in this unforgettable jungle adventure.

title: Fruit Jam Master
description: Enter the juiciest and most addictive puzzle adventure ever. Enjoy a fun logic puzzle game in Fruit Jam Master. You need to help all the animals leave the grassland to win. Pay attention to the color of the food. Animals can only pass through when the food matches their own color.

title: Royal Family Tree
description: Step into the world of royalty and unravel the secrets of noble bloodlines in this captivating family tree puzzle game. Your task is to complete intricate royal family trees by using the clues provided, piecing together generations of kings, queens, princes, and princesses.

title: Parking Master Urban Challenges
description:
A realistic 3D parking simulator where you can hone your driving skills and become a real parking master!
Get behind the wheel of realistic cars of different sizes and maneuver through crowded city streets, parking in the most difficult places.
Pass all the tests, become a parking master and prove that you can do any maneuver!

title: Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow
description:
Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow – Relaxing Brain Teaser
Connect the pipes, let the water flow, and solve hundreds of satisfying puzzles!
Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow is a relaxing and addictive puzzle game where your mission is simple: fix the pipes and restore the flow of water. Perfect for all ages, it's the ultimate brain exercise you can play anytime, anywhere.

title: Zombie Raft
description: Zombie Raft is a survival game. The zombie apocalypse is coming and it's time for a raft survival game! Protect yourself and other survivors from the looming zombie tsunami, and push them all back, it's your responsibility to survive on the raft! Squeeze the vehicles forward and push them if necessary! Keep going, escape the zombie tsunami, and conquer the barren land! If stranded survivors are found, you need to rescue them! Join us and experience the best zombie game!

title: Donut Run
description: This thrilling arcade game is designed for adventure enthusiasts and fans of active gameplay. Step into the role of a fearless rolling character, racing through dynamic levels filled with vibrant settings and exhilarating obstacles. With easy-to-master controls, you’ll quickly dive into the action, experiencing a blend of tension and adrenaline. Each level features diverse obstacles and traps, ensuring every run feels fresh and exciting.

title: Motorcycle simulator offline
description: Get ready for an exotic stunt master & adventurous high ground city jumper sports bike simulator game.For bike racing fans and motor bike riders this exotic sports bike simulator is a real fun game. Just start your engine and hit the gas of an extreme bike to experience the stunt master thrill of high ground city jumper motorbike racing & enjoy sports bike sound.

title: Rainbow Friends Hide And Seek
description: Rainbow Friends Hide And Seek is an exciting and fast-paced hide-and-seek adventure game set in a colorful yet dangerous rainbow world. Step into this thrilling role-playing experience, choose your role, and get ready for an unforgettable adventure.

title: Meme challenge.io
description:
"Meme Challenge.io" is straight-up chaos.
It’s you vs. the wildest, most unhinged character names ever like Spaghetti Tualetti and Bombardino Crocodilo. Tap fast, think faster, and don’t get caught slippin’. It’s giving brain-lag.
Only real ones can vibe their way to the Wcup.

title: TapKO
description: One-tap fighter game. From the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride, get ready to rumble with TapKO - the knockout idle game that packs a punch! Jab, bob, and weave your way to the top, and train your fighter to become the ultimate boxer.

title: Thor Merge
description:
Dive into Norse mythology in Thor’s Merge! 
Merge planets representing the Nine Realms to create even bigger worlds. 
Play solo to reach the highest score or battle others in PvP mode to climb the leaderboard and achieve ultimate glory in Asgard!

title: Snake Puzzle Escape
description: Get ready for a fast-paced puzzle experience where your goal is to wiggle the snake through each grid while avoiding obstacles and other snakes. With simple controls and a variety of challenging levels, this is the perfect game for quick play during your free time.

title: Park Them All!
description: Park Math Mania is a free, fun casual arcade where players drive, park, and solve math puzzles just like a cool math game. Perfect for students searching for “cool math game,” “freebie parking fun,” or “parking puzzle” challenges. With clever car-parking levels and brain-teasing math twists, this freebie delivers the ideal blend of driving excitement and math brain training. Download now for a unique parking dash and learning adventure!

title: Sniper Shooter 2
description: Aim and Shoot! Kill the bad guys and accomplish missions to become the master hitman. Just turn your device to aim and TAP TO SHOOT and kill.

title: My Dreamy Flora Fashion Look
description: Welcome to My Dreamy Flora Fashion Look. Girls! You know that spring is on its way when you see the trees starting to bud and bloom, and the bulbs you planted last fall start to sprout out of the ground. Join with Ellie and their friends to celebrate the most beautiful and colorful season.

title: Cubatoria Merge 2048
description:
Welcome to the exciting world of Cubatoria Merge 2048! This game combines elements of the classic 2048 game with a three-dimensional visual design, which makes it unique and exciting.

The game is designed for fans of puzzles, logic games and those who appreciate a creative approach to classic concepts. Cubatoria Merge 2048 promises an exciting immersion in virtual space with the opportunity to enjoy a new visual experience.

title: Brainrot Mega Parkour
description: Step into the wildest parkour adventure yet. Brainrot Mega Parkour brings together four intense modes, forty handcrafted levels, and a cast of hilarious characters in a single high-speed package. Whether you’re climbing an endless tower, racing across a platform full of traps, escaping a rolling lava ball, or surviving a lava flood, every level pushes your reflexes and timing to the limit.

title: The Stone Miner
description: Become the ultimate mining tycoon in The Stone Miner! Drive your powerful mining machine through various fantasy terrains. Crush, collect and smash stones like never before! Steer your mine cart through rocks of different colors and materials and enjoy the exhilarating experience of stone mining. Sell collected stones for gold, and unlock new areas full of rare materials and surprises! Upgrade your vehicle to mine faster and deeper, turning your gear into a true beast!

title: Two Supra Drifters
description: Drift through 3 stunning drift tracks and show how well you can steer the wheels of a powerful supra. Go head to head with your friend in a drift battle and see whose a better drift racer, customize your ride with stunning body colors, underglows and cool rims. Are you ready to showcase your drifting skills?

title: Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY
description:
Style Anna’s outfits and bring her fairy tale story to life!

Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY takes you into a magical world of creativity and fashion! In this charming paper doll game, you’ll help Anna dress up for a variety of occasions, from costume parties and romantic dates to festive holidays like Halloween and Christmas.

title: Phrasle Master
description: Guess words of wisdom, proverbs and sayings in a fun brainteaser. Tap the words to make a phrase, and try to solve a riddle in 5 attempts using the color hints. As you progress, hidden phrases get longer, so you will need to apply all your logic and puzzle-solving skills to cope with the solve the riddles. Besides, such word games let you expand your vocabulary and learn foreign languages in a fun way. So, prove your skill as you decipher witty quotes and proverbs in a free word game online.

title: Pinball Basketball
description: A captivating fusion of classic arcade pinball excitement and thrilling sports gameplay. Flip your paddle skillfully to keep the ball in play, aiming for the basketball hoop while enjoying the stunning minimalist art and responsive design that make every moment electrifying and addictive.

title: Deadly Parkour
description:
Dynamic Duo:
Take control of two distinct characters, each with their own strengths and abilities. 

Precision Platforming:
Immerse yourself in the thrilling world of precision platforming, where every jump matters. Test your reflexes and hone your skills as you traverse 70 meticulously hand crafted levels.

title: Zombie Idle Defense
description: Prepare for a zombie showdown in Zombie Idle Defense! In this exciting idle defense game, you will be the last line of defense against wave after wave of zombie attacks! Build your defenses,upgrade your weapons, put your automatic turrets on fire, and fight off the undead!

title: What's The Difference?
description: What's The Difference? is a casual Spot the Difference game where you must find differences in two similar images.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Geometry Dash Maze Maps
description: Welcome to one of the funniest and coolest skill games - Geometry Dash Maze map. Here, you will dive into the fun and amazing world of geometric shapes. Your character will become a cool glowing square with a big smile. In the game, you will help the square overcome all obstacles. To do this, you will need all your dexterity and cunning, because a difficult path awaits you ahead. Be careful and try to click quickly to make the jump in time. Think over all actions and prepare for the next jump,

title: Bubble Mania Shooter
description: So easy to play, yet challenging to master - welcome to the wonderful bubble universe! Get ready for a game with colorful shooting action where the fun never ends! Sharpen your aim, perfect your shots, blast bubbles, and claim the highest score.

title: Super Brain
description: In the game, you'll control a character sprinting down a track, but your path is blocked by a series of "Gates of Knowledge." Each gate presents an interesting question, and you must choose the lane corresponding to the correct answer in a short amount of time to pass through. A wrong choice ends the run! As you get faster, the questions become trickier. This game tests not only your knowledge but also your on-the-spot reaction skills. Come join this dual challenge of brain and speed!

title: Mr. Dude: King of the Hill
description:
The famous criminal Mister Dude found himself on the top of a mountain, where residents were waiting for him, ready to hand him over to the police. Help him avoid getting caught, defeat all enemies and conquer the mountain!
Game Features:
Your goal is to knock out, drag and throw your opponents using physics and fun ragdoll effects. The game has a huge number of different objects that you can manipulate and throw at your opponents, different enemies, levels and modes.

title: Merge Tower Hero
description: Dive into Merge Tower Hero, an exhilarating online puzzle - Merge game that sharpens your mathematical thinking while exhilaratingly combining action, strategy, and combat. Assemble your team and tackle challenging battles that require not only strength but clever gameplay strategies to prevail!

title: Solve the Cube Wooden Blocks 2D!
description:
• This is a game in which you have to connect wooden blocks! In the game you have a playing area where you must connect blocks to fill the line! Once the line is full, the blocks will disappear, giving you the most
points! Compete with friends or colleagues on the leaderboard! Enjoy your game!

title: Ship & Fish
description: Ship & Fish is an exciting survival game where the player controls a ship and tries to stay alive by avoiding dangerous fish. The game requires fast reflexes and smart movement, as fish attack from all directions. The longer you survive, the higher your score grows and the more challenging the game becomes.

title: Jump Dash
description:
Leap, soar, and survive in this fast-paced rhythm platformer!
Step into the intense world of Jump Dash, where every move must be perfectly timed. Test your reflexes as you jump, glide, and flip through treacherous levels packed with spikes, traps, and relentless obstacles.

title: Draw War
description: Unleash your creativity in Draw War. This is a wonderful strategy game. Here drawing meets battles. Build a hero lineup, draw your legions, then unleash the power of your army. The numbers show the soldiers summoned. Click to send Shielded Soldiers, Soldiers on Horseback, or Super Beasts.

title: Mad Dash
description: Mad Dash is a free puzzle platform game.  You are a minotaur trapped in one of the last mazes in the galaxy: a maze of levels. You'll have to jump and dash over treacherous obstacles and challenges to make it through this maze. Many of the platforms are too far apart for you to make it with a simple jump. That is why the mad dash was created. The mad dash happens when players need to jump over spikes or a crevasse that their normal jump wouldn't traverse.

title: MR RACER - Car Racing
description: MR RACER - Car Racing is a thrilling and challenging racing game that will excite you! Race at high speed with stunning supercars and beat the traffic. This game provides a very easy-to-control car movement and is extremely fun to race.

title: Fox Coin Match
description: Money can be exchanged stacking the same money!  If you exchanged money, the count will not advance. You can erase them by making thousand bills around them.

title: Shape-Shifting
description: Choose different vehicles to adapt to various terrains, allowing yourself to navigate through the terrain faster and become the first in the race.

title: Hunting underwater spearfishing
description:
Hunting underwater spearfishing – a realistic diving adventure!

Dive into underwater exploration as a diver in a wetsuit, hunting with scuba gear. Explore lakes, seas, and oceans, encounter 30+ marine species, and marvel at coral reefs. Freediving, underwater hunting, and treasure searches await! Upgrade harpoons, masks, and tanks, battle predators, and survive hostile depths. Discover new locations and earn rewards to improve with every dive!

title: Doge Rush Draw Home Puzzle
description: Welcome to Doge Rush: Draw Home Puzzle! It's full of lovely adventures. There are two ways to play this game. In the Animal family party, you should help the dog and cat find their food and guide them home, drawing a line between the dog and cat's correct food. And avoid them bumping into each other. If they hit, they will get dizzy and the game will fail.

title: Funny Fever Hospital
description: Join Ruby, a schoolgirl battling a unique lung virus, in Funny Fever Hospital! Diagnose, operate, and dress her for the cosplay competition. Cure her, and she'll thank you with a dazzling dress-up session! Experience medical fun and fashion in one pet-tastic game!

title: Battle Zone 2D
description: Immerse yourself in a dynamic 2D top-down shooter. Fight on a vast map, search for weapons, ammo, and gear to survive epic battles. Use strategy, cover, and tactics to become the last survivor. Simple controls, fast-paced matches, and thrilling gameplay make the game accessible to everyone. Test your skills, defeat enemies, and prove that you are the best fighter!

title: Pets vs Bees
description: Protect the cute superhero dogs from the attack of the bees.immediately draw a barrier and protect the superhero dogs before the bees get out of their hive.

title: Cooking Festival
description: Cooking Festival is a delicious management sim that will let you bake, fry and grill around the world! Become the master chef the cooking world has been waiting for and whip up some homemade pancakes, grill juicy ribs, bake aromatic original Italian pizzas, and serve delicious ice cream that everyone loves!

title: Princess Dress Up Run
description: Run, collect, and dress up like a true princess. Race around the fantasy track. Collect all kinds of gorgeous princess dresses, shoes and accessories along the way according to the goal. Create the perfect princess look. And watch out for obstacles and traps, such as suddenly broken platforms, flames, etc.

title: Monster School vs Siren Head
Bottle challenge
description: This is a puzzle game, the game provides different volumes of the kettle, according to the game level prompts each kettle needs a different magnitude, to reach the required magnitude of the prompt can be cleared

title: Powerwash Simulator - 3D Wash
description: There’s no stain too tough, no dirt too thick that you can’t handle. So gear up, point your washer, and get ready to bring the shine back to everything around you.

title: Circuit Master
description: Circuit Master is a puzzle game where you aim to get a green light by connecting the circuit correctly! Arrange the wires, fans, and machines in the right places, then turn on the button to see the electricity flow. Only the correctly connected circuit will make the green light shine. Use hints if you need help.

title: Bubbly Lab
description: Bubbly Lab is a physics puzzle game where you have to catch all the adorable bubbles in the laboratory. Use a super strong vacuum cleaner to get the bubbles into the flask. Use your logic to move lab items to help you get bubbles. Solve interesting puzzles in this fun and unique game!

title: Stick Kill 3D
description: Play as a stickman armed with a pistol in this puzzle-based shooter, where precision and clever thinking are key. Find the right angle, line up your shots, and eliminate enemies in creative ways. Each level becomes more challenging, testing your accuracy and problem-solving skills.

title: Sort Master
description: Get ready to bring order to the chaos in Sort Master, a relaxing yet addictive online puzzle game. Test your logic and observation skills as you sort, match, and organize a variety of fun challenges — from colors to everyday objects. Whether you’re playing on your phone or computer, enjoy the satisfying feeling of tidying up and completing each level with perfection. Play for free and become the ultimate Sort Master!

title: Save The Piggies
description: Save The Piggies is a car-moving game. But this time you are moving not a car, but a pig or other animal. From a few pigs to a large group of pigs, you need to click on the pigs to move forward until all the pigs are there. The pig must be successfully removed to pass the level.  Have fun!

title: Brick Match
description: Brick Match is a fast, fun puzzle game! Tap to match colorful bricks, trigger combos, and beat brain-teasing levels. Use boosters like the Shuffle, Colour Bomb, Extra Moves, and Row Blaster to blast through tough spots. Can you clear the board and beat your high score?

title: Woody Tap Block
description:
Woody Tap Block is an addictive puzzle game where you have to use logical thinking to move and remove wooden blocks in the right direction. With simple yet challenging mechanics, the game offers a relaxing yet engaging experience.
Plan your moves in the correct order to clear all the blocks.
As you progress through levels, the puzzles become more challenging with new obstacles and block types to overcome.

title: Hook Pin Jam
description: Hook Jam is an addictive puzzle game where you untangle and release hooks to clear the board and earn rewards. Each level challenges your logic and planning with increasingly complex layouts. Solve puzzles efficiently, unlock new stages, and test your problem-solving skills in this clever, satisfying brain game.

title: Last to leave circle Obby
description:
Last to leave circle Obby - is a dynamic online game in the style of Roblox, where only the most dexterous and persistent can win! Exciting obby challenges, dangerous traps and intense battles with other players are waiting for you. Going outside the circle means you're out, and the circle is getting smaller and smaller!

Tense obby challenges that will test your reaction and agility.
Roblox-style game with unique multiplayer.
Ability to compete with friends and players from all over the world.

title: Wave Chic Ocean Fashion Frenzy
description: Welcome to the game in which every new tide carries a new wave of style! Help two girlfriends to celebrate the new beach season with dignity. Each of the girls has her own unique sense of fashion and style. Combine swimsuits with a variety of accessories to create unique summer looks. And don't forget to pick up a surfboard or a sapboard. Get ready for adventures on the water and to become the most stylish on the whole coast!

title: Dollys Restaurant Organizing
description: This exciting game is designed to help you organize better and release your stress. You will draw inspiration and creativity of storage through [Storage Master], and pack your life comfortably and cleanly. You can organize and clean objects by category, storage location and cleaning order. This game will bring you the creative inspiration of storage, allowing you to easily apply it in real life. Similar to a jigsaw puzzle, you have to pick the right object and put it in the right place

title: Obby vs Zombies
description: Obby vs Zombies is an innovative, fun-filled action game that captivated the gaming world. It challenges players to create mazes of different characters to fend off hordes of incoming zombies. The wide variety of options for attack and defense make this a highly strategic game with lots of replay value.

title: Geometry Flap
description:
Enter a world of bold outlines, sharp corners, and pure reflex. In Geometry Flap, you control a shapeshifting arrow darting through a black-and-white maze of geometric chaos. Tap to flap, weave through deadly gates, and dodge precision traps in this high-speed gauntlet of skill.

Features:
One mistake = instant crash.
Simple to play, brutally hard to master.
Unlock dozens of slick arrow skins.

Will you survive the rhythm of geometry?
Challenge your reflex. Flap to glory.

title: Syder Hyper Drive
description: Syder Hyper Drive is stunt car game, based on futuristic theme. Perform different stunts from varieties of available vehicles, complete missions in this endless game.

title: Emilys Hotel Solitaire
description: What are you going to do when you go on a journey to a tropical island? Will you spend your time in a lounger, enjoying the hot sun and cold drinks, or become a master surfer? Our heroine Emily has arrived at this heavenly place to make her honorable grandfather Douglas Kirby’s dream to build a hotel of his own come true.

title: 2 Player Battle
description: Seeking an exciting way to spend time with friends and family is most significant. Look no further than Party Battle, the ultimate 2-4 player game! With 30 different games, this exciting collection has something for everyone.

title: Chicken Banana Quest
description: Help the Chicken and Banana to solve all puzzle quest and find the play button. Use your skills to solve the puzzles before the lives run out and complete all levels with the less possible clicks

title: Screw Jam - Fun Puzzle Game
description:
Remove screws in correct order to get rid of the boards. 
Match the removed screws and complete the level. 
Test yourself with this amazing brain teaser!

title: LOL Funny Dance
description: LOL Funny Dance is a hilarious 2D game where you can distort the faces of politicians and celebrities to create the funniest expressions! Drag and move different points on the image to stretch, twist, and transform their looks into ridiculous and exaggerated versions. Watch them dance and react as you manipulate their faces in real time. Play the LOL Funny Dance game now.

title: Poppy Player Puzzle
description: Solve the riddle of this fun game. In each of the many stages of Poopy Player Puzzle, the small player must use his or her wits to direct the doll to the right keys that will release it from captivity.The goal of the game is to rescue the small doll from Poppy's clutches to progress through the levels, you'll need to keep an eye on the things in the labyrinth; pressing certain buttons may speed up the game or remove hazards.

title: Nuts & Bolts Puzzle
description:
Play Nuts and Bolts Game, the new brain-challenging puzzle to challenge and test your IQ. Train your mind while relaxing with multiple levels of our game.
Become the master of logic puzzles and enjoy the creative gameplay we have prepared especially for you.

title: Lucy All Season Fashioninsta
description: "Lucy All Season Fashionista" invites you to four seasonal clothing adventures! From spring to winter, create combinations that cover every season. Experience the freedom to create your own style by complementing Lucy's fashion with accessories. This fun and heartfelt game is ideal for anyone who is interested in fashion!

title: Obby Parkour Racing
description:
Welcome to Obby Parkour Racing – the game where speed, agility, and style collide to create the ultimate racing challenge!

Jump, grind, and dodge through dynamic obstacle courses on your snowboard! Prove your mastery in a world where parkour isn't just on foot
it's on a board. Every race is a new test, and only the fastest and most agile champions will claim victory.

title: Grenade Simulator
description: Begin the most explosive simulator experience ever. Grenade Simulator is an adrenaline-pumping explosion simulator where you can freely throw grenades, drop mines, and trigger massive blasts. This isn’t just a casual game.

title: Tsunami Brainrots Online
description: Tsunami Brainrots Online is a fast-paced survival experience inspired by meme culture and chaotic movement gameplay. Players must escape a massive tsunami wave while exploring dangerous areas, collecting valuable brainrot characters, and returning safely before time runs out. The game offers an online single-player mode where you can interact with others through chat, as well as a local 2 player option for shared-screen action.

title: Cityquest
description: Guess the hidden city by using compass directions and unlocking helpful hints like continent, flag, time zone, and name clues.

title: Squid Game Hunter
description: Step into the thrilling world of Squid Game – a fast-paced game for stealthy and strategic players that takes you on a wild adventure as a hunter with a deadly knife. With multiple Squid games enemies to kill, challenging missions to complete, and rewards to collect, this game will test your skills and keep you on the edge of your seat.

title: Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits
description: Dive into Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits! Combine fruit balls in this unique blend of 2048 and billiards. Enjoy ASMR sounds, complete juicy levels, and compete with others. Master your merging skills and embark on a fun fruit-filled adventure today!

title: Impostor among us: Escape from prison
description:
The traitor ended up in a space prison. But the impostor does not plan to stay there for long. You play as an impostor who must go through all the traps, solve puzzles and kill all the enemies on the level. Once the imposter has neutralized all the amogus, he will be able to break out of prison. But the evil among will not let you go into space so easily.

- 100+ varied and colorful levels.
- To kill the enemy you need to approach him.
- Logic tasks and puzzles!
- Boss battles!

title: Speedrun platformer
description: A classic platformer with coin collection and jumping on monsters' heads. But if you complete the levels as quickly as possible, you can get into the leaderboard.

title: Hex Sense
description:
Guide Mochi across risky hex lands. His hex sense lets him read the numbers that give clues of how many dangers are nearby, and use them to find a safe path. Reveal tiles, flag traps, and guide brave Mochi to the Exit. 

Hex Sense is a minesweeper-style puzzle on a field of hex tiles. Some tiles hide dangerous hazards, but clues around them help you figure out where it's safe to go. Cross several unique chapters filled with new kinds of hazards and clues.

title: Number Place Travel
description:
Fill the grid with numbers 1–9 so that no same number appears in any row, column, or 3×3 block!
Tap a cell and choose a number to place it.
You can make up to 3 mistakes. Fill in everything correctly to clear the puzzle!

title: Crazy Hill Climbing
description:
Get ready for the ultimate hill racing adventure in Crazy Hill Climbing! Race through steep hills, rugged terrains, and tackle challenging obstacles. With 15 unique levels and cars to unlock, upgrade your vehicles and customize your rides as you strive to conquer each track and perform daring stunts.

* Use coins to upgrade your engine, tires, suspension, and more to improve performance on rough terrains
* Execute daring front flips and back flips to earn extra points and boost your score

title: Farm Match Seasons 2
description: Farm Match Seasons 2 is one of the new Match 3 games from the creators of the legendary Garden Tales, Forest Match and Solitaire Farm Seasons. Your friend Poppy needs your help to look after the most beautiful farm in the village. Together you will harvest strawberries, collect flowers and protect butterflies on their farm fields. What is important that you keep the farm free from weeds! The second sequel features a BIG content update with new levels and a relaxing soundtrack to enjoy!

title: Magic Solitaire
description: Welcome to the amazing magical world of solitaire! Here you can make yourself at home, playing layouts on a tavern table by the fireside, or in the shade of an oak tree by a majestic rushing waterfall. Your fairy helper will guide you through this magical world full of mystery and ancient secrets. Magic World Solitaire is the classic solitaire you love in an exciting new world.

title: Domino Adventure
description: Discover three match durations to suit your style. Showcase your skills and logic in each round, and use strategic moves to outplay your opponents. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts seeking endless fun and challenges.

title: Bubble Pop Fairyland
description:
Bubble Pop Fairyland is an exciting bubble shooter game that’s very highly addictive!
Aim, shoot & pop all the color bubbles using epic blasters to clear the board and win coins!

Bubble Pop Fairyland is a fun and relaxing puzzle game designed to keep your mind sharp at any age.
It also is a perfect brain training and fast solution making game
You will have hours of fun shooting & matching the same colored bubbles!

title: Help The Duck
description:
Helping Little Duck
In this Skill Game help a charming little duckling to fall into the tub with water. Throw the water in the correct places so that the duckling falls directly into the tub. - Play Helping Little Duck Free and Enjoy!

title: Stickman Football
description:
"Stickman Football" is an exciting 2D game where you take on the role of a stick football player and compete against an opponent. Your goal is to score using various moves and tricks.

You have the ability to teleport to the ball after a shot to improve your chances of scoring. This adds a strategic element to the game, as you must choose the right moment to use teleportation to get the ball into the goal.

title: Us Army Car Games Truck Driving
description: Army truck 3d simulator is a realistic military game in which they supply their weapons, foods also use them for the transportation of troops for war and to protect their city from terrorist attacks. Are you looking forward to have an amazing modern army truck driver game to drive your army vehicle and become an army machines driver, as much as you want.

title: Numicolor
description: Discover a creative way to relax. Coloring by number helps you focus and switch off from daily worries.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: The Shape
description: "The Shape" is an online geometrical puzzle game where players create figures based on given references. This fun, educational experience is suitable for all ages, featuring a seamless, gesture-based user interface.

title: Blob Hero
description: In Blob Hero, you become a brave hero facing endless waves of enemies and monsters! This survival game offers a true rogue adventure experience. You control a blob hero, choose basic skills and upgrade to survive.

title: Slingshot Chicken
description: Launch your fearless chicken from a slingshot and smash through unstable pig-filled towers in an endlessly fun physics adventure! With infinite levels and constantly evolving challenges, no two runs are ever the same. Perfect your aim, trigger explosive TNT chain reactions, and watch satisfying collapses unfold as you clear every pig before your shots run out. The fun never stops — how far can you go?

title: Anomaly Content Record
description: Welcome to Anomaly Content Record, a terrifying horror adventure where your only goal is to escape and survive. You’re a field investigator sent to explore a restricted research facility that went silent overnight.

title: Woodoku Block Puzzle
description: Welcome to experience the Woodoku Block Puzzle! This is a super fun casual puzzle game, especially for relaxing in your free time. The gameplay is very simple and very challenging! There are four modes you can choose from.

title: Bubble Shooter Panda Blast
description:
Step into the colorful world of Panda Blast, where your mission is to rescue baby pandas by popping bubbles. Mama Panda needs your help to bring her lost cubs home. With vibrant graphics, charming animations, and exciting puzzles, this game is perfect for all ages.
Match three or more bubbles to clear them, free trapped pandas, and progress through hundreds of fun levels. Use powerful boosters, enjoy daily rewards, and experience smooth animations that bring the adventure to life.

title: Brain Puzzle Tricky Choices
description: This is a brain puzzle game. In this Brain Puzzle: Tricky Choices game, use your imaginative brain to solve all the tricky brain puzzles, find the right storyline, and then pass the level. It may be easy to get through all the levels, all you need to do is make the right choices, sounds simple but it's not. Join the game and use your imagination and creativity to solve the puzzles!

title: OMG Word Rainbow
description: Step into the vibrant world of OMG Word Rainbow, an engaging word finder game illuminated by the beauty of the rainbow. Explore a colorful mosaic of letter tiles, where drawing lines along neighboring letters unveils words inspired by the enchanting spectrum of colors; enhance your journey with rewarded ads, allowing players to effortlessly skip levels in this captivating linguistic adventure.

title: Knife.io
description: Knife.io is a fast-paced 2D battle game where you throw knives at your enemies to eliminate them! Dodge incoming attacks, aim precisely, and take down as many opponents as possible without getting hit. With vibrant worlds to explore and tons of unique characters to unlock, every match is a colorful and action-packed challenge. Play solo or team up with a friend in local multiplayer, only the sharpest player will survive!

title: Find the Vampire
description: Looking for an exciting vampire game? This is a casual 3D game where you act as a hunter to put an end to the vampire uprising. Your task is to identify the bloodsuckers among us, destroy them and free the city from the threat.

title: Revoxel 3D - Voxel RPG Shooter
description: Immerse yourself in a dynamic voxel-style RPG shooter with a cyberpunk atmosphere. A dark futuristic city overrun by a tech corporation awaits you, along with endless battles with robots and monsters, character development, and constant action in the spirit of a shooter RPG.

title: Space Strike: Galaxy Shooter
description:
Space Strike is an arcade galactic shooter 2D. Experience adrenaline-pumping aerial combat and battle your enemies in classic space combat!

Join  Space Strike today and become an ace pilot defending and liberating various space planets from waves of enemies! Take control of a spaceship in a galactic shooter, shoot down every group of aliens and prevent enemy forces from taking over the entire galaxy!

title: Mahjong Lines
description: Mahjong Lines is a relaxing logic puzzle in the mahjong connect style. Find matching tile pairs and clear the board by linking them with a valid path. With classic mahjong tiles, simple rules, hints, and lots of levels, it’s perfect for both quick sessions and thoughtful puzzle-solving.

title: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire
description: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire is the classic one lower one higher solitaire you know and love. It sounds easy: just remove cards from the board one higher or lower than the next card in the deck. But there's a whole other world behind these simple rules! The constantly changing locations and new cards on the board will keep you on your toes using new strategies. Don't expect to be an expert if you don't play for a couple weeks!

title: Mr Long Hand
description: Immerse yourself in the quirky and delightful world of Mr Long Hand, where you take on the role of a stickman with incredibly long arms. Your mission is simple yet endlessly entertaining: use your elongated limbs to swing through obstacles, solve puzzles, and embark on thrilling rescues. Mr Long Hand offers a unique blend of creativity, challenge, and humor that is sure to captivate players of all ages.

title: Monster Slayer Merge & Survive
description: Welcome to our thrilling adventure game! Your journey consists of two main parts: merging items and exploring dungeons. Embark on this epic journey, combine powerful items, and conquer the depths of the dungeon!

title: Party Games Mini Shooter Battle
description: Party Games: Mini Shooter Battle is a battle-royale shoot-em-up game with 2D cartoon models. In 4 modes, you can shoot other players to earn scores for coins and gems. Then you can buy more roles and guns in the Shop. Your character can aim at the closest target automatically so that you only need to fire and dodge bullets from enemies. More kills and less death will make you claim more coin and gem rewards. Good luck!

title: Highway Bus Rush
description: Welcome to the heart-pounding world of "Highway Bus Rush" – a game that propels you into an exhilarating journey along infinite highways. Brace yourself as you surge forward, navigating the ever-changing landscapes with precision and speed. The relentless pursuit of adrenaline awaits, as you weave through traffic and conquer challenging obstacles.

title: Vibrant Hearts Glamour vs Punk
description: Two best girlfriends, Lily and Roxana, are striking opposites. Lily is the personification of tenderness and romance, dressed in airy pink dresses decorated with sequins and floral patterns. Roxanne is the true queen of punk rock, with her black leather dresses, gothic earrings and bold hairstyles. But do not forget about the third girlfriend, Melody, who masterfully combines both styles. Players will be able to experiment with outfits and choose which one is best suited for Valentine's Day!

title: Farm Animal Sort Puzzle
description: Welcome to Farm Animal Sort Puzzle, a fun and relaxing casual puzzle game set on a lively farm. Your mission is simple but addictive: match the appropriate animal or vegetable to the customer's needs. Sort adorable farm animals into the correct spaces and enjoy the satisfying challenge of smart organization.

title: Crime Theft Gangster Paradise
description: Crime Theft Gangster Paradise is an action-packed gaming experience set in the neon-lit streets of Las Vegas. Players become ruthless gangsters, armed with a vast array of weapons. Engage in intense shootouts while collecting valuable loot

title: Moscow Metro Driver 3D
Grill Party
description: Welcome to Grill Party! Step into the exciting world of grilling and become a master at crafting tasty skewers! In Grill Party!, you’ll experience a thrilling match-3 puzzle game where you’ll arrange meats, seafood, and veggies to create perfect combos. Serve up mouthwatering treats and show off your grilling skills!

title: Obby Tower Parkour Climb
description:
Dive into the parkour adventure with Obby in the Hell Tower game theme. Climb colored platforms and get to the finished platform for a great reward.
The game contains three hell tower maps easy, medium, and hard. Play these maps in two different modes normal mode and challenge mode. Try to do your best timing in challenge mode in either single-player or 2 player game mode. You can also compete against your friend in normal mode in the 2-player game mode option.

title: JailBreak : Escape from Prison
description: Experience the thrill of jailbreak escape, find a way out to freedom in our adventure filled jailbreak games! In this exciting jailbreak escape journey, you’ll take on the role of a character trapped behind jail bars, where every level presents unique challenges and exciting mini games, leading to the final goal of prison escape. Your goal in this prison games? Outsmart the system, solve clever puzzles, and find a way out in this immersive jailbreak escape adventure.

title: Dreamy Home
description:
It's not just a game, but a warm and peaceful adventure that helps you feel the magic of ordinary moments.
Opening box after box, you will find personal items and lovingly find the perfect place for them. Room by room, step by step, you will assemble mosaics of memories and emotional stories hidden in simple objects.

title: Hit ball
description:
Hit ball is a fast-paced arcade game with roguelike elements, in which you fight off waves of enemies with ricocheting balls! With each shot you break through obstacles, knock down monsters and earn experience to improve your abilities.
Dozens of levels with unique traps, walls, boosting balls and dangerous bosses await you. Collect boosters, pick up abilities, regenerate health and strategize to survive the battle!

title: Duck Luck
description:
Guide a lovable duck and his humorous friend and drop numbered blocks that merge when identical numbers come into contact, creating larger numbers that help clear the board. 
As you strategize and match numbers, you'll earn points. 
The goal is to accumulate the highest score possible by making as big of a number as you can.

title: Ninja Obby Parkour
description:
Step into the thrilling world of Ninja Obby Parkour, where every level is a test of speed, agility, and strategy. Packed with hundreds of unique obstacle courses, this game combines competitive racing with ninja-style combat and dazzling customization options.

From smashing glass doors at checkpoints with your ninja power to unlocking powerful bonuses like speed boost, giant mode, and flight, every run feels fresh.

title: Digging Moles
description: Dig, guide, and solve! In this physics-based puzzle game, tap or click to dig tunnels and create paths for cute, ball-shaped moles. Your mission is to help each mole roll into the correct colored pipe. Use gravity and smart digging to guide them through challenging terrain filled with obstacles, slopes, and surprises. Timing, precision, and a bit of creativity are key! With charming visuals and satisfying mechanics, this game offers fun and brain-teasing puzzles for players of all ages.

title: Animal Basketball
description: Dive into Basketball: The Power of Moe! Team up with adorable animals, unlock over 100 magical balls, and enjoy physics-powered hoop action. Play through arcade, championship, and mission modes on dazzling courts in this fun and addictive basketball party!

title: Muscle Challenge
description: Run, eat healthy foods and proteins and avoid harmful foods, drinks and obstacles in the Muscle Challenge game! Defeat your enemies with the strength and muscular body you gained at the end of the race! The enemies get stronger in each level, so you have to get better too... If you want, you can also play the game in challenge mode with your friend in 2 Player mode.

title: FrontWars.io
description: FrontWars.io is a multiplayer .io battle game where players battle it out to dominate as much of the globe as possible. You begin small and slowly work your way to conquer the world.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Zoo Anomaly Simulation
description: Experience a zoo mutation crisis like no other. In Zoo Anomaly Simulation, a peaceful zoo has turned into a nightmare filled with mutated animals, and you’re the only one who can stop the chaos! Enter a first-person shooting experience like no other. Explore the eerie zoo environment, grab your weapons, and fight back against giraffes, zebras, elephants, etc.

title: Tile Fruits
description: In Tile Fruits, embark on a delectable adventure packed with vibrant fruits and captivating challenges! This 2D tile-matching game tests your strategic prowess as you aim to connect three identical fruits to advance through progressively difficult levels. Each match removes the fruits from the board, but beware: having more than seven different types of fruits on the board at once results in a loss.

title: Koko Loco Block Blast
description: Think fast, blast smart — can you beat your best score? Blast blocks, fit shapes, and outsmart the grid in this fast-paced puzzle challenge! Every move counts: clear space, chain combos, and keep the board from filling up. With smooth controls, colorful blocks, and quick rounds, it’s perfect for casual fun or deep strategy. Easy to pick up, hard to put down — how high can you climb the high score ladder?

title: Wreck The Tower
description: Take control of a powerful tank and unleash destruction in Wreck The Tower, an explosive demolition game where precision and power determine your success! Your mission is simple: demolish buildings by firing your tank’s bullets repeatedly until the structure collapses. But be careful not to hit the moving walls. If you hit them, your bullet will ricochet back toward you, adding an extra challenge to your aim.

title: Vehicle Fun Race
description: Vehicle Fun Race—an exhilarating arcade game with 3D stickman characters. Collect motorcycles, cars, boats, and helicopters to reach the finish line. No need to grab vehicles; your character can handle all terrains. Dive into water? No problem—control their swim. Special helicopters await on final platforms. Ready to race? Let’s roll!

title: Helix Crush
description: "The gameplay is very simple and can be accomplished with only one finger, yet it will also bring you countless challenges and fun. You need to jump and fall through the helix tower, cutting through the colorful fruit and cake slices on the way. But be careful! There are many obstacles and traps along the way, and it will be up to your reflexes and luck to get through them.

title: Mahjong At Home - Scandinavian Edition
description: Immerse yourself in the minimalist elegance of the North with 'Mahjong at Home: Scandinavian Winter Edition'. This high-quality Mahjong game celebrates the sleek, modern design of Scandinavian style, blending festive themes with clean, sophisticated aesthetics for a uniquely cozy winter gaming experience.

title: Hippo Supermarket
description: Meet Jack Ma, a cute hippo who dreams of opening his own supermarket. But he doesn't know how to do it. He needs your help to make his dream come true.In this fun and addictive game, you need to merge the same items to get higher-level items, and then sell them to earn money. The more money you make, the more you can help Jack Ma build his store.

title: Zombie Survival
description: Play the nervous zombie adventure in Zombie Survival. Explore a dangerous world occupied by zombies. Collect various weapons to attack zombies. Move smartly and set traps to defend yourself from massive zombie waves. Explore abandoned cities, dark alleys, and creepy forests - each level is a new adventure! Challenge big zombie bosses and prove your survival skills under pressure! Collect many useful items to fix your broken tools.

title: Ping Pong Battle Table Tennis
description: Want to have an intense table tennis battle? In Ping Pong Battle - Table Tennis, you will become a ping pong pro and compete with your opponents in a fierce competition! This game combines realistic paddle manipulation with exciting match simulation.

title: Pew Pew Dose
description:
Build the weapon of your dreams and blast through hordes of cute… yet deadly zombie rascals!

Welcome to a bright and crazy post-apocalypse where only the most creative weapon makers survive. In this arcade 3D mayhem, you start with a simple gun… and end up wielding a monster built from multiple barrels twisted together into insane contraptions!

Craft without limits: attach barrel to barrel, add magazines, boost firepower, and create unique weapons that would make enemies run away…

title: Word Art – Color Book Puzzle
description: Discover a delightful gaming experience that combines the thrill of solving word puzzles with the joy of bringing art to life. In Word Art – Color Book Puzzle, you’ll embark on a creative journey where words are the key to unlocking vibrant colors and stunning illustrations.

title: Merge Haven
description: Merge items to restore the café to its former glory, uncover hidden secrets, and discover its mysterious past. Start merging today to reveal the café's enchanting story!

title: Brain Test IQ Challenge 2
description: Ready for the wonderful challenge of your brain power? Brain Test IQ Challenge 2 is here! This is a brainstorming puzzle game that combines drawing, jumping, multiplayer battle, maze escape and other ways to play. Activate your brain in a second! In draw master, underlining guides the character into the correct restroom.

title: Crazy Bike Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning muscle car through 2 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills.
