Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Crazy Bike Stunts PvP!

title: 99 Nights (Bloxd.io)
description: 99 Nights is an action-adventure game where your survival skills are put to the test, and nighttime creatures attack you after dark. Gather resources, weapons & build your defenses along with other players while you unlock tools to help you level up and protect your base.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Dino Slide
description: A puzle slide game wher you have to feed Dino. Move Dino with the keyboard arrow or swipe. Each level you have to complete the goal that consist in eating fruits and vegetables.

title: Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d
description: Roll your block across challenging 3D platforms and drop it into the goal hole to solve each puzzle. Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d is an addictive block puzzle game that tests your logic, spatial thinking, and problem-solving skills across dozens of mind-bending levels.

title: Bubble Shooter Witch Tower
description: Bubble Shooter: Witch Tower is a fun, free web game that takes you into a magical world of witchcraft. Ascend the Witch Tower by bursting as many bubbles as possible in this thrilling bubble-shooting puzzle adventure. Progress through levels, rescue adorable pets, and restore the Witch Tower piece by piece. With hundreds of enchanting bubble-shooting challenges, there's always something new to conquer. Play anywhere, anytime—no time limits!

title: Pyramidz2
description: PyramidZ 2 is, as the name suggests, the sequel to PyramidZ. It's a Match-3 game where you have to slide a row or column to align Egyptian symbols. This version is faster and allows for more combos.

title: Sprunki PopIt
description: Sprunki PopIt: The Ultimate Bubble-Popping Adventure! Get ready for hours of bubbly fun with Sprunki PopIt, the free-to-play online game that kids everywhere are going crazy for! It’s fast, colorful, and packed with exciting challenges. Your goal? Pop all the bubbles, dodge obstacles, and conquer level after level of pure popping chaos!

title: Labuba Merge
description: Labuba Merge is a fun and relaxing casual merge game where you combine adorable fluffy Labuba to unlock bigger, cuter, and funnier versions! Perfect for kids and adults, this addicting merge puzzle game will challenge your strategy and bring a smile to your face. Just drag, drop, and merge your Labubas to evolve them into new forms. How big can your Labuba grow?

title: Archery Master - Bow and Arrow
description:
Join archery adventure and become a bowmaster! Aim, shoot and hit the bullseye!

Pick your bow, defeat other archery masters and don’t let them take you down! Join in this fun and challenging adventure and have fun. Bow masters can really challenge your casual game skills but have no fear! If you enjoy bow and arrow games, then prepare to defeat other bow masters, earn coins, score, and become the ultimate bow master!

title: Panda Mahjong Classic
description: The panda has a challenge for you. You will face five tests on your way to the top. Attempt to finish all stages and earn the honor of being a Mahjong master.

title: Chicken Blast
description: Tap to match chickens of the same color in this challenging match-3 game. Use powerups to score bonus points and aim for the high score. Enjoy a responsive design and endless gameplay that's easy to play but hard to master.

title: Typing Adventure
description: Get ready for a fast-paced typing challenge in Typing Adventure! Type the words above each enemy to defeat them before they get too close. The longer you survive, the faster they come! How long can your fingers keep up? Battle endless waves and test your speed in this thrilling typing survival game!

title: Taxi Simulator 2024
description:
Are you prepared to play an awesome simulator? Taxi Simulator 2024 is an online game set in an open environment with objectives to help you improve your cab driving abilities. Pick up the passengers and drive them to their destination, following the directions and exploring all of the maps to locate the streets and addresses.

This game includes many game modes to keep you entertained; accomplish the stages in taxi or open mode, and freely explore the whole landscape.

title: Block Puzzle 3D
description:
Block 3D Puzzle is a colorful logic game where you need to place 3D blocks on the board in the right order. Every move turns into a bright visual effect — when you place a figure and complete a line, the entire line lights up with that block’s color!
Plan your moves carefully, fill the lines, and clear space for new blocks. The game combines relaxing gameplay, smooth animations, and stylish 3D graphics, making every puzzle a true visual delight.

title: Gem Deep Digger
description: Dive deep into the underground world of Gem Deep Digger. In a fun and addictive simulation game,you dig, collect, and upgrade to uncover hidden treasures. With simple one-button controls, anyone can become the ultimate miner. Use your dig to carve through layers of dirt and rock, uncovering sparkling gems in the ground.

title: Rope Sorting
description:
In the game “Rope Sorting” you are waiting for exciting puzzles, where you need to sort the ropes. Pass an infinite number of levels, collect stars, use aids, be the first!

Rollback actions - allows you to return to the previous step to take a different path.

Adding a coil - makes it easier to pass a level by adding another empty coil.

title: Reflect Beam: Laser Logic
description:
Logic game where every move changes the beam’s path. 

5 modes - 5 types of challenges.
Tunnel: rotate shapes and guide the beam through narrow passages.
Labyrinth: draw a safe path to the exit.
Same Colors: remove blocks of the right color to open the route.
Obstacles: move elements and clear the way for the beam.
Time is limeted: solve faster and more accurately before time runs out.

title: Otu
description:
In OTU, you control a nimble triangle bound to a circular orbit. Your mission is simple: stay alive as long as possible. But the universe is against you! Spheres close in from the void, shrinking bars attempt to crush you, and lethal rotating lasers force you to keep moving.

Think you’ve mastered the rhythm? Every 10 seconds, the game throws a Random Debuff at you. From screen-shaking earthquakes and inverted controls to pixelated vision and orbit shifts—no two runs are ever the same!

title: MergeDuel.io
description: Merge Duel is a fast-paced 1v1 battle game where strategy and quick decisions lead to victory. Merge and upgrade your cannons to summon powerful units and counter your opponent in real time. Every match challenges your tactical skills as you adapt to new enemies and situations. Climb the ranks, dominate the leaderboard, and enjoy vibrant visuals, smooth controls, and intense duels from start to finish.

title: Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition
description: Relive 2024’s hottest fashion trends in Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition! From TikTok-inspired makeup to glamorous red carpet looks, this game brings together the best dress-up challenges of the year! Style iconic outfits, create bold beauty looks, and transform your favorite characters for every occasion—festivals, dates, holidays, and more! Are you ready to be the ultimate fashion trendsetter? Play now and own the style game!

title: Merge Brick Breaker
description: Welcome to Merge Brick Breaker, the ultimate fusion of ball merging and brick-breaking action! Get ready to embark on a thrilling adventure that challenges your strategic skills and reflexes.

title: Trial Xtreme
description: Trial Xtreme is an exciting game in which you have to get a new experience from driving a motorcycle. Experience a sea of adrenaline while riding a motorcycle and passing 30 levels with dizzying and spectacular obstacles.

title: Flight Sim Air Traffic control
description: Flight Sim is a game where you have to guide aircraft to their landing zones, keep the skies safe to complete the levels to get high score.

title: Freddys Nightmares Return Horror New Year
description:
Immerse yourself in this 3D game there's no need to fear the monster Freddy. To familiarize yourself with the area, play the escape mode. You'll find yourself in a mysterious, forgotten city on New Year's Eve, with snow making escape difficult. Go out of there as quickly as possible and see how far you can go.

Freddy Krueger and his snowman minions will relentlessly pursue and attack you in the second game mode, but you have the option to bring weapons to help you destroy them.

title: Kung-Fu Little Animals
description: In this game you will become the new assistant of the Great Master. Your task is to teach funny and dexterous animals the art of kung fu. With simple clicks, you will train your newly minted students so that they become worthy successors of the Great Master's work. Passing the game, you will discover new funny animals, as well as new beautiful and unusual locations. Join the kung fu team and have fun teaching the little animals martial arts!

title: Bunnyhop and Surf Maps
description: Game that brings bunnyhop and surf from "Counter Strike" straight to your browser! The game features a variety of parkour maps, many knife skins, unique bunnyhop mechanics, the ability to accelerate with a knife, and the opportunity to compete with other players to see who can reach the finish line first.

title: Beauty World and Fashion Stylist
description: Play stylist game just now! This is the most fashionable salon for girls, where you can not only do makeup, but also dress characters in nice outfits! Change accessories, hairstyles and interior, take screenshot and save stylish images to the gallery!

title: Bus Driver
description: Being a bus driver is tough! Navigate carefully through traffic, pick up passengers, and avoid collisions. Think you have what it takes to master the roads?

title: Murder Mystery
description: Murder Mystery – A fast-paced social deduction game. One player is the killer, another the sheriff, the rest are innocents. Use logic, stealth, and quick decisions to survive or expose the murderer. Perfect for high engagement and multiplayer retention.

title: Formula Racers
description: Formula Racers is the ultimate HTML5 browser top-down arcade racing game - no download required! Race on any device across 10 thrilling tracks, tackle dynamic lap tracking and real-time placement, and earn coins to unlock and upgrade cars (engine, gearbox, steering, brakes). This online racing game features HD graphics, responsive design, immersive SFX & music - perfect for mobile & desktop gamers seeking fast-paced, addictive arcade action!

title: Farm Triple Match
description:
Looking for a fun tile-matching puzzle game? Try Farm Triple Match, a fresh take on tile-matching for puzzle lovers! This mahjong-inspired game is easy to learn but offers exciting challenges.
Beat levels and build your own farm with cute animals and a lovely garden.
Classic gameplay with a modern twist for relaxing brain training.
Explore a variety of tiles featuring fruits, veggies, animals, and more.
Use boosters to conquer tough puzzles and keep progressing. No time limits—play anytime!

title: Match Fighter
description:
Match Fighter is a vibrant match-3 fighting game where classic martial arts meet puzzle action! Play as a skilled warrior and take on a series of powerful opponents. Match tiles to strike and unleash special moves in intense one-on-one duels. Every combo you make fuels your fighting spirit. Outsmart your enemies, climb the ranks, and prove yourself as the ultimate martial arts champion!

Can you match your way to victory?

title: Pool 8
description: Pool 8 is a relaxing yet challenging billiards-style puzzle game where players must sink all the balls into the pockets in the correct order. The game follows a step-by-step movement system, requiring strategic planning to clear the table efficiently. With smooth mechanics and progressively difficult levels, Pool 8 offers a unique twist on classic pool gameplay, perfect for puzzle and strategy lovers.

title: Mini Games Casual Collection
description:
Mini Games: Casual Collection is an online game. The gameplay is simple, fun, and addictive, so
you won't be able to stop playing. There is no stamina display. You can play anytime anywhere. You can use hints to help you pass when you are stuck on a level. If you have any problems playing this game or have any suggestions for this game, please leave us a message. If you like our games, please share them with your friends to double the fun!

title: Boyfriend For Hire
description: Pushed by her mom to start dating, studious Amy hires charming transfer student Javier to pose as her boyfriend. Rival Christie, jealous rumors, and a flirty study partner turn the act into real complications. Choose outfits, make tough choices, and decide if this love is real—or just for show.

title: Traffic Rider
description: Traffic Rider is a first-person driving bike endless game that puts you on a motorbike for an exhilarating ride. With a full career mode, lifelike bike sounds, and detailed graphics, it redefines arcade racing.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Sprunki Space Challenge
description: Get ready to soar through the stars in Sprunki Space Challenge an intergalactic online adventure where brave kids take flight to save the galaxy. This wild space ride throws you into the cockpit of a zippy space rover where danger lurks in every asteroid and rocket burst. But worry not: Sprunki is here to lead the charge. It is all about timing, reflexes, and sky-high jumps that send you sailing straight into the action.

title: Stick Master Teleport
description:
Jump onto walls, throw knives, and teleport to your enemies ⚔️ to defeat them with a single strike.
Prove your ninja reputation by eliminating bad guys before they even notice.
Walk the tough path of a ninja to become a true ninja assassin!

title: Head Soccer Arena
description: Head Soccer Arena takes you into a fast-paced football world! Play 2-player matches on the same device, dive into quick games, or rise through 15 leagues in Career Mode. Win matches, collect coins and diamonds, and upgrade your power-ups—ice, lightning, anvil, big head, and more! Unlock new characters and dominate the field with strategy, skill, and speed. Every match is a step toward football glory!

title: Air Block
description:
Jump, Place Blocks, and Conquer Challenging Levels!

In Air Block, use quick reflexes and smart block placement to overcome obstacles and enemies. With limited blocks per level, every move counts! Avoid saws, spikes, and unlock doors to progress—plus, grab those bananas if you can!

Game Modes:

Single Player – Test your skills across unique levels.
Two-Player Mode – Compete in quick place challenges and mini-games like Beach Ball, with more to come!
Think you’ve got what it takes? Start now!

title: Hunt And Seek
description: Ready for a challenge of intellect and strategy? In Hunt And Seek, enter an adventure world filled with puzzles that will stimulate your brain as you search for hidden characters! This game offers endless fun and challenges, suitable for boys and puzzle enthusiasts! At the beginning of each level, an arrester is randomly selected. At the beginning of each level, a random arrester is selected to become a giant and start hunting.

title: Stickhole.io
description: "Stickhole.io" is a thrilling game with single and two-player modes. In single player, swallow stickman and defeat bosses within time limits. In two-player mode, compete to eat the most stickman, then battle with collected characters. Dynamic gameplay and colorful graphics make it addictive and fun.

title: Woop Crawl Up
description: Woop Tower Climb is a fun arcade climbing challenge where you crawl, jump, and dash your way up endless towers. Dodge tricky traps, survive obstacle course chaos, and master platformer moves to reach the top. Perfect for fans of climbing games, jump games, obstacle course adventures, and even cool math games students search for online. Addictive, casual, and funny—how high can you Woop Crawl Up?

title: Doodle Football
description: Doodle Football is an imaginative and captivating 2D casual game that combines creativity, strategy, and fun. Your goal is simple: guide the football into the goal while overcoming exciting challenges across a variety of themes like the lush greenery of fields, the scorching sands of the desert, and the frosty landscapes of ice.

title: HeroBall Adventures 2
description: It’s time to embark on a brand new adventure in this great game, this time in a spherical theme! Heroball Adventures 2 is finally here! It’s a fun game where heroball has to save his friends who were abducted by a strange machine on an otherwise calm day. Control the character, jump over obstacles and try to save all of your friends. Be sure to try to get to the end of each level. Collect points and unlock new abilities!

title: Snow Rush 3D
description:
Snow Rush 3D is a fun sledding game that tests speed and reflexes for winter sports enthusiasts, playable in both 1 and 2 players! Try to reach the longest distance by overcoming obstacles and ramps on a challenging snow-covered track, or challenge your friend!

Snowmen, obstacles and tricky turns await you along the way. How far can you go and how many gifts can you collect?

title: Mona Lisa Fashion Experiments
description: Welcome to a small humorous adventure in which you will try on the role of a stylist for the most mysterious lady of all time - Mona Lisa Gioconda. Connect the past and the present by mocking trends and memes. Each of your changes is a small work of art, and each outfit immediately causes fireworks of pleasant emotions. There is no framework here - only freedom of expression. And the variety of images is guaranteed to make your time in the game unforgettable!

title: Flying Bill
description: Fold, throw, and soar through levels with just your bills! Collect cash, unlock cool purchases, and reach for multiplier balloons. As you progress, watch everything you’ve bought transform into a big special gift.

title: TB Avataria Life Girl
description:
Hey, how about helping me decorate my house? You need to decorate my home beautifully, buy me nice clothes, and feed me. Let's get started — right now, I have an empty house, and we need to furnish it together. Let's make it look organized and cozy! Before I get too hungry, you must take me to the café to eat, or I might lose my life from hunger!
We also need to earn money. To make money, reach the computer and use the money-making app. You can either buy things or continue earning more money!

title: CUBE KING
description:
Show them who's the real King here!

New cubes appear from the portals at the bottom. Your task is to connect cubes with the same numbers by moving them from one stack to another!

You get coins for every merge. Use them wisely:
Upgrade a selected cube!
Unlock new portals with cubes!
Increase the starting level of cubes!
Extinguish burning cubes or instantly shatter the ice on all frozen cubes!

But be careful: if a stack overflows, the game ends!

title: STALKER-Strike
description: STALKER-Strike is a tactical online shooter inspired by CS and Valorant — but set in a deadly Zone filled with anomalies. Fight as stalkers or special forces in fast-paced PvP battles where hazards can shift the tide. Level up, survive traps, and prove your skills. Love CS, Standoff, or Valorant? Then step into the Zone and become a legend in this intense fusion of esports action and danger!

title: Pet Merge
description:
Merge adorable pets! 
Combine cute companions to unlock rare and magical species. 
Pass exciting levels in adventure mode or beat your high score in the classic mode.
Let's Play! Meow

title: Drive Ahead Sports
description: Want to begin a pixelated sports showdown like no other? In Drive Ahead! Sports, you’ll be behind the wheel of amazing vehicles, engaging in exciting soccer matches! Enjoy the rush of driving and the fun of the game! Use your skills to kick the ball, attack the opponent's goal, and aim for victory!

title: American Block Sniper Online
description:
With its informal look reminiscent of Minecraft, American Block Sniper Online is a top-notch first-person action game. In addition to a large variety of adversaries and stages, the game has an extensive arsenal of weaponry.
American Block Sniper Online is a first-person action game in the world of Minecraft where you must defeat all the enemies in each level before time runs out.

title: Cowboys Duel
description: In this fast-paced cowboy showdown, players can either compete solo or engage in a thrilling duel against a friend, testing their reflexes and quick draw skills. Will you answer the call to become the fastest and most skilled cowboy around?

title: Poptropica
description:
Join millions of players in the adventures of Poptropica!
Complete unbelievable quests, written by Jeff Kinney, author of the Diary of a Wimpy Kid series!
Customize your character and adopt pets! Decorate your clubhouse and hang out with friends! There's so much to do in Poptropica!
And don't forget to collect prizes and compete with your friends - will you be the island champion?

title: Tropical Merge
description: Dive into Tropical Merge, the ultimate merge game where you can create your tropical paradise! Immerse yourself in a vibrant world as you match and combine resources in three groups to craft exciting new items.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Trolley fun
description: Trains connect cities and carry goods, but bandits are constantly attacking them! Collect resources, upgrade your train to repel all attacks!

title: Dream Restaurant 3D
description: Ready for the ultimate restaurant challenge in Dream Restaurant 3D? Embark on a journey to establish your very own restaurant empire. The mission is straightforward: swiftly attend to customers, prepare delectable hamburgers, stack them up, and gracefully serve them around the tables. Expand your team by hiring proficient waiters, accumulate profits, and gradually construct an unparalleled restaurant empire!

title: Arrow Escape: Puzzle
description: Arrow Escape: Puzzle is a logic puzzle where arrows block each other, and your goal is to untangle routes and clear the level by choosing the correct move order.FeaturesShort levels you can play in a minute.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: From Nerds to Beauties
description: Two girlfriends, the Little Mermaid and Arlene, embark on a world of stylish transformation. Their appearance, full of flaws, requires magical intervention. In the first stage of the game, the girls go through a series of fun cosmetic procedures that give them glowing skin and luxurious hair. At the second stage, you will have to become a stylist, choosing hairstyles, fashionable clothes and accessories. Each of your actions brings the heroines closer to their dream of becoming real beauties!

title: Color Maze
description: In Color Maze your mission is to light up all the paths on the map to complete a level. Make the right move, avoiding obstacles or just pay attention to not get stuck in a corner. Beat all the 20 levels with increasing difficulty to show yourself that you are the real king of Color Maze.  Remember, if a level is to hard for you, you can always skip it clicking or touching the reward button in the up right corner of the screen.

title: Tiles of the Unexpected 2
description:
Tiles of the Unexpected 2 is a puzzle game with a dark military theme and refined gameplay. Clear groups of tiles, set off chain reactions, and plan each move carefully as the board shifts and collapses. The classic mechanics from Tiles of the Unexpected return with smoother controls and a sharper, more intense style.

The game introduces a new Time Attack mode, where speed and strategy are key. Clear tiles quickly to push back enemy forces and survive as long as possible.

title: Last Standing
description: Players are dropped onto a map and start without weapons. The map is scattered with a wealth of weapons and equipment. Players need to constantly explore and collect these resources to enhance their survival ability and combat power. The core goal of the game is to be the last survivor. Usually, there are multiple players in each game, and they are randomly distributed on the map.

title: Car Parking Master 3D – Real Driving Simulator
description: Car Parking Master 3D is a realistic driving and parking simulator that tests your precision and control skills. Navigate tight turns, avoid obstacles, and park perfectly in challenging 3D environments. With smooth controls and progressive difficulty, every level pushes your driving accuracy to the limit. Can you complete all stages without crashing?

title: Earth Defender
description:
Earth Defender is a fast-paced arcade game where you control a spaceship orbiting around planet Earth. Deadly meteors are flying toward the planet, and it's your mission to stop them before they crash into Earth.

Your ship circles the planet. Time your moves carefully and collide with incoming meteors to destroy them

Tap to change your orbit direction and intercept as many meteors as possible. Survive the meteor storm and defend Earth for as long as you can!

title: Blue VS Red
description: Sort blue and red items as fast as you can! Drag or use arrow keys to send each item to the correct zone. Build combos, beat the timer, and earn coins to buy power-ups. Challenge yourself in solo mode or compete against AI bots. How high can you score in 30 seconds?

title: Metro Escape
description: On Metro escape you must search the room for items that will help you escape. Search for itens in the metro and use them to solve the puzzles. Look carefully at the various patterns around the metro and solve the riddles. Good luck to search for your way to escape!

title: Traffic Light Simulator 3D
description:
"Traffic-Light simulator" is an immersive simulation game where players take on the role of a traffic controller tasked with managing the flow of vehicles through a bustling city intersection. Set against the backdrop of a dynamic urban landscape, players must strategically operate a traffic light to prevent congestion, accidents, and ensure smooth traffic flow.
With each passing level, the intensity and complexity of traffic increase, testing the player's decision-making skills and reflexes.

title: Arrow Slide Puzzle
description:
Arrow Slide Puzzle — Logic Puzzle Game
Arrow Slide Puzzle is a clean and engaging logic puzzle game where you slide arrows across the board to clear the field and reveal a hidden picture. Simple rules turn into deep challenges that test your logic, planning, and spatial thinking. Perfect for fans of arrow puzzles, sliding logic games, and relaxing brain teasers.

? Download now and start solving today!

title: Dress Up Run
description: Play Dress Up Runway, the ultimate fashion dress up game where style meets speed! Collect outfits, change looks on the go, and shine in the final runway walk. Perfect for players searching “dress up game,” “fashion game,” or “makeover run,” this stylish challenge lets you become a fashion queen while racing through exciting levels. With princess vibes, outfit makeovers, and endless glam fun, Dress Up Runway is the best free fashion challenge for US teens and students!

title: Good Sort Master: Triple Match
description:
A new game for those who like to put order on the shelf, in the closet, in the refrigerator. Collect identical items in groups of 3 - sort, arrange, tidy!
Connect items three in a row, create coziness! Cleaning has never been so interesting and fun!
A simple and relaxing game for women and men of all ages!

title: Stack Fall
description:
Smash the floor! 
Are you under stress? Maybe Stack Fall can help you to release the stress. 
As your ball keep breaking the floors to get to the goal, every smashing will ease your stress. 
It's time to break some stacks!

title: King Of The Hill
description: Exciting pixel races to the top of the mountain! Choose a bright car, avoid all obstacles and reach the top of the mountain in one piece! Compete with other players and become the King of the Mountain!

title: Royal puzzle Burst
description: Tap blocks of the same color to make them burst and eliminate attacking blobs! Enjoy a straightforward and gratifying game with intuitive controls.

title: Zig Snake
description: Zig Snake is a fast-paced arcade game where your snake zigzags forward nonstop! It's the ultimate test of your reaction speed, focus, and timing. Dive into this retro-style snake game, challenge yourself, and try to beat your high score!
